reviews.title: Great for customizing.
reviews.comment: Case is fantastic. Hue is a little more yellow than expected but overall still pretty green. There’s a ton of options for mounting and routing cables. All panels are very easy to remove and clean. Airflow is excellent. Would like some option to hide cables a little better but they remain hidden overall. It’s a bit bigger than expected but about the same as most midsize cases. Fits bigger graphics cards no problem.
reviews.author: Ricky Mares

reviews.title: Unique, Sturdy, Beautiful PC Case, no regrets!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/F1wMbOneA8L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/718lkdCot2L._SY256.jpg I love this case!
Pros: Easy to build in, very sturdy and high-quality feeling, roomy, unique, great cable management, and cools amazingly! Glass front and mesh back lift right off and easy to re-install. Love the back “window blinds” ventilation slots, room for large psu up top.
Cons: Decently heavy, but that’s not the worst thing in the world. Other than that I don’t really have any!
reviews.author: Brandon B.

reviews.title: Sweeeet momma this is a nice case
reviews.comment:
First off, amazing case. The ease of install even with push/pull on 360mm AIO was easier than most cases. I was able to fit not one, but two 360mm AIOs in this case, and on top of that a EATX motherboard easily with no hassle.
The build quality is superb, amazing value for the money and a home run to Hyte for the solid build quality and very luxurious feel for a case in this caliber.
reviews.author: Darius D

reviews.title: Great Case
reviews.comment: It was larger than expected but it is very well made and looks amazing. It was very easy to build in with plenty of space for good cable management.
